name: ONNX Runtime Mobile
notable_features: ONNX Runtime Mobile is the mobile/embedded deployment path for ONNX Runtime, optimized for Android and iOS
Supports ONNX format models with quantization support (int8, int4, uint8)
Execution Providers: NNAPI (Android), CoreML (iOS), XNNPack (CPU), QNN (Qualcomm)
Small binary footprint compared to full ONNX Runtime - designed for app bundling
Supports LLM models via ONNX Runtime GenAI API (2024+) with prefill/decode loops
No dependency on PyTorch or TensorFlow at runtime - self-contained C++ runtime
hardware_caveats: ONNX format requires conversion from PyTorch/TensorFlow - no direct GGUF or safetensors support
LLM support is newer and less mature than llama.cpp or MLX - fewer optimized kernels for transformer architectures
NNAPI and CoreML delegation depends on OS version and device capabilities - not all ops are delegated
No continuous batching or paged KV cache - single-stream inference only
Quantization quality depends on the calibration data used during ONNX quantization
best_for: Deploying ONNX models to Android and iOS apps with a single runtime
Cross-platform mobile inference where ONNX is the interchange format
Qualcomm devices with QNN backend for NPU acceleration
iOS devices with CoreML delegation for Neural Engine
avoid_for: Desktop or server inference - use full ONNX Runtime or vLLM instead
Models only available in GGUF format - conversion to ONNX is non-trivial
High-concurrency serving - no batching or scheduling support
Maximum performance on Apple Silicon - MLX is faster on Metal
notes: ONNX Runtime Mobile is the standard path for deploying ONNX models to mobile devices. It is distinct from full ONNX Runtime in that it strips unused ops and backends to reduce binary size. The GenAI API (2024+) adds LLM-specific optimizations but the ecosystem is less mature than llama.cpp for local LLM inference.
